use_case.name: AI-Assisted Meeting Record Generator
use_case.description: Combine meeting audio recordings, agenda documents, and participant lists into a structured, evidence-cited meeting record capturing decisions, actions, and unresolved issues.

business_spec.current_process: A project coordinator listens to the meeting recording, checks the agenda and participant list, and manually prepares the meeting record.
pain_points: Action tracking is inconsistent across meetings
Decisions are difficult to trace back to their source (recording or agenda)
business_spec.proposed_solution: An AI-supported pipeline that combines the meeting recording, agenda document, and participant list to produce a reviewable, structured meeting record that separates agenda topics, discussion summaries, decisions, assigned actions, unresolved issues, and conflicts, each backed by source citations.
business_spec.success_criteria: Supported decisions and actions are captured accurately with evidence; missing owners, dates, or decisions are not invented.
business_spec.poc_goal: Process fixtures/poc_input_bundle.json (referencing the meeting WAV, agenda PDF, and participant JSON) via a CLI accepting --input <bundle_path>. The run must exit successfully and save non-empty, parseable JSON to poc/output/ capturing the frozen meeting decisions, actions, unresolved issues, and the known date conflict, with audio citations as file_name|start_timestamp|end_timestamp (HH:MM:SS) and agenda citations as file_name|page_number. Unsupported owners, dates, budget approval, and SSO decisions must be left unset, and review_status must be pending_review. Output is compared semantically against fixtures/expected_meeting_record.json.

technical_spec.data_sources: Per-meeting bundle (fixtures/poc_input_bundle.json) referencing one WAV recording, one PDF agenda, and one JSON participant list. No live system integration in this PoC.

model_preferences.notes: Self-hosted Whisper endpoint is available for transcription (local_api_base/local_api_key). Extraction uses Azure OpenAI.

technical_spec.security_constraints: Meeting material is internal. Access limited to the project team and the designated reviewer. No connection to calendar, project-management, document-management, or identity systems is required.
technical_spec.evaluation_requirements: CLI run must exit successfully and save non-empty, parseable JSON to poc/output/. Compare output semantically against fixtures/expected_meeting_record.json, focusing on correctness of decisions, actions, unresolved issues, conflicts, and citation validity/format.

field_descriptions.title: Meeting title
field_descriptions.meeting_date: Date the meeting was held (subject to conflict detection against the agenda)
field_descriptions.participants: List of {name, role}, normalized against the supplied participant list
field_descriptions.topics: List of {title, discussion_summary} -- one per agenda topic actually discussed
field_descriptions.decisions: List of {decision_id, statement, citations} -- decisions explicitly made in the spoken meeting
field_descriptions.action_items: List of {action_id, description, owner, due_date, uncertainty_reason, citations}
field_descriptions.unresolved_issues: List of {description, citations} -- topics raised but not resolved
field_descriptions.conflicts: List of {description, citations} -- contradictions between agenda and spoken content, or within the spoken content
field_descriptions.review_status: Approval state of the record; starts as pending_review

target_output_spec.missing_value_policy: Do not infer unsupported facts (owners, dates, budget approvals, SSO decisions, or any other fact not explicitly stated). For action_items, set owner/due_date to null and provide uncertainty_reason when not explicitly stated in a source.
validation_rules: Every decision, action_item, unresolved_issue, and conflict must carry at least one citation.
Audio citations use a single string: file_name|start_timestamp|end_timestamp, with HH:MM:SS timestamps.
Agenda citations use a single string: file_name|page_number.
An agenda item alone is not a decision -- only the spoken meeting content determines what was actually decided.
When the agenda and spoken content conflict, record the conflict and follow the explicit spoken decision.

assumptions.text: Other stakeholders beyond the project team and approving project manager, and the expected quantified value (e.g. hours saved), were not specified and are recorded as unknown pending user confirmation.
Risks were not specified and are recorded as unknown pending user confirmation.
No formatted PDF report was requested; the initial PoC produces JSON output only.
No domain-specific vocabulary, codes, or controlled lists were specified; assumed none are required for extraction.
Deployment platform, authentication method, and retention period were not specified; these are out of scope for the local PoC and must be defined before any production packaging.

Business-process elicitation (swimlanes/roles, external parties, manual steps, rejection path) was not specified. Assumed roles are limited to project_coordinator (uploads input), the GAIK AI pipeline, and project_manager (reviewer); no external parties; no additional manual steps.
Rejection path was not specified; assumed default behaviour is a clean discard (BPMN 'Rejected' end event) rather than a rework loop back to the coordinator.

LLMJudge is run on the same provider/family as extraction (azure_openai) for credential simplicity in the PoC. Using a different model family for the judge would reduce shared-model bias but was not specified by the user.

steps.name: Provide meeting recording, agenda, and participant list
Parse agenda PDF with page-level citations
Project manager reviews and approves the meeting record

traceability.required_by: technical_spec.input_types contains audio; citations require file|start|end timestamps -> transcription_model=whisper_local
technical_spec.input_types contains pdf (agenda); citations require file_name|page_number -> use_markdown=False
output_type=structured_json; multi-source field extraction into MeetingRecord schema
technical_spec.human_review=yes; pre-screens extraction before project manager review
